Over the next week week, Republicans are going to spend all their time trying to pass legislation sending A BILLION DOLLARS of your money to help Trump throw corrupt billionaire parties.

The ballroom is the biggest scam out there. Here's why.

Video

There's going to be a lot of talk about tariffs as Trump goes to China.

So remember this - Trump's tariffs aren't trade policy. They are political weapons. You get exemptions from the tariffs if you pledge political allegiance to Trump. 

That's why we are losing factory jobs.

Video

Going on @allinwithchris on @MSNOWNews at 8pm to talk about what we could have done with $29 billion to help Americans instead of blowing it on a corrupt, inane war of choice.


ABC News (@ABC)

The Iran war is estimated to have cost $29 billion, the acting Pentagon comptroller told lawmakers Tuesday during a House Appropriations hearing. abcnews.link/uFIPpEK

Secretary Hegseth said today Trump has "all the cards" in negotiations with Iran.

This was so concerningly disconnected from reality, I went to the Senate floor to explain how Trump's incompetence has given Iran far more leverage today than during the nuclear talks in 2013.

Video

This is how an out of touch billionaire president thinks.


Acyn (@Acyn)

Trump on Iran War:

Reporter: What extent are Americans’ financial situation motivating you to make a deal?

Trump: Not even a little bit. I don't think about Americans’ financial situation

a. uh $200 million is still A LOT of taxpayer money for parties!

b. “other Secret Service priorities”….like the ballroom!


Andrew Desiderio (@AndrewDesiderio)

News: Thune just said 20% of the $1 billion in the reconciliation bill would be for ballroom/East Wing security (~$200 million). The rest would be for “other Secret Service priorities”

America's chief Middle East negotiator - Jared Kushner - is almost completely dependent on Middle East government investment in his chief business. It's probably the biggest conflict of interest in American diplomatic history and we should be talking about this way more.

Video

Not a single one of Trump’s (ever changing) war goals is close to being achieved. Iran still has the majority of their missiles and drones. They still have a nuclear program. They are more powerful globally today than before the war. An utter disaster.

Video
I will be on @cnn with @kaitlancollins in a few minutes to talk about the ongoing, spiraling disaster of the Iran War.

Good morning. 

Gas is over $6 a gallon in many places. Farms are going bankrupt. Billions are being wasted on a war that’s making us weaker. 

And this week, Republicans will spend their time trying to get taxpayers to fund Trump’s parties.


Burgess Everett (@burgessev)

$1 billion for East Wing renovation projects gets its budget Byrd Bath starting this week -- some talk about it being at risk under reconciliation rules

Trump and the Iran hawks are ignorant of history. 

Yes, the Iranian economy is in tatters. But no, that will not cause them bow to us. Nations have a peculiarly high economic pain tolerance when being attacked by an outside power.

(see Vietnam, Afghanistan, Ukraine etc)

So grateful for the two moms in my life - Cathy and my own amazing mother. I also stopped by the gospel brunch at the legendary Black Eyed Sally’s in Hartford to spread some cheer to other moms on Mother’s Day.

Prices are spiraling, families are hurting, and all Republicans care about is building a Marie Antoinette ballroom for their billionaire parties.


Jake Sherman (@JakeSherman)
